The only signal of TRUTH the RAG measurement has: latency and degradation rate say whether the search RAN, never whether it was RIGHT. Same role as `search` — whoever can read the result is who can judge it. Re-voting the same chunk of the same search overwrites your own vote rather than adding a second one (unique per actor), so the metric measures accuracy and not enthusiasm.
